summary: The session discusses the establishment of the tenor AI Factory, a sovereign AI cloud designed to meet the needs of telecom operators and other organizations requiring secure data handling. Key principles include sovereignty, security, and sustainability, with a focus on providing AI services while adhering to national regulations. The speaker shares insights on service offerings, technology architecture, and the importance of an agile operating model in the fast-evolving AI landscape.

key_points: Overview of the tenor AI Factory and its purpose as a sovereign AI cloud.
Importance of national security and regulatory compliance in AI services.
Introduction of GPU as a service and subsequent development of AI development as a service.
Co-creation with customers to enhance user experience and security.
Challenges in operating GPUs and ensuring data security.
Implementation of a defendable architecture for cloud security.
Transition to a DevSecOps model to enhance collaboration between development and operations.
Importance of automation in onboarding and managing customer services.

key_takeaways: Establishing a sovereign AI cloud requires a focus on security, sovereignty, and sustainability.
Customer co-creation is essential for developing effective AI services that meet regulatory needs.
Adopting a DevSecOps approach can significantly improve operational efficiency and security in AI deployments.
